## Change and purpose

Describe the concrete behavior changed and its reason.

## Verification

List relevant MATLAB checks, cohorts/scenarios and limitations.
For model changes, include model/config hashes, split provenance and per-grade results.

## Checklist

- [ ] No medical-image derivatives, datasets, credentials or generated caches included.
- [ ] Evidence covers the changed behavior; failures and unresolved cases are disclosed.
- [ ] README, model card and validation documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] No final-test threshold fitting or unsupported clinical claims.
